meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编码前产出决策完备的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不先理清方案就写代码总返工。
copy.tagline_en: Produce a decision-complete work plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan before starting implementation.

howto.what: Claude 会以规划顾问 Prometheus 的身份工作:先并行做只读探索,把需求整理成一份决策完整的计划文件,期间不碰产品代码、不做实现;只有你明确同意后才写入计划,执行由单独会话启动。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求走 ulw-plan 流程、或要求在实现前先出计划时触发,单独的 ulw 运行不会自动激活;激活时首行打印 ULW-PLAN MODE ENABLED!。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 给登录接口加限流写一份计划
say.note: 先只读探索,再给审批简报

say.text: 先别写代码,把重构支付模块的计划拿出来
say.note: 计划只在你明确同意后才落盘

say.text: 这份计划要高精度审查
say.note: 标记 review_required,批准后跑高精度审查

howto.what_en: Claude works as Prometheus, a planning consultant: it runs read-only exploration, then writes one decision-complete work plan. It never edits product code or implements; execution starts in a separate worker session.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run never self-activates it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to write a plan for rate limiting on the login endpoint
say_en.note: Read-only exploration first, then an approval brief.

say_en.text: Don't code yet — give me a plan for refactoring payments
say_en.note: The plan is written only after your explicit okay.
Sets review_required; momus review runs after approval.
